t: A web block coding tool for building 3D models, with a teacher dashboard.
steps: Open the BlocksCAD site and register a basic or educator account.
Enter a school or district access code during registration if you have one.
Set up classes in the teacher dashboard.
Read the privacy policy. The site collects several kinds of student data.
Note the minimum age of 13 and ask about under 14 consent.
Ask the vendor for school license prices.
